title: The Marauder's Map: B\'{e}zier Manifolds Reveal Hidden Surfaces for Model Merging and Ensembling
abstract: arXiv:2611.33353v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Neural circuits are famously more robust than deep networks. This is often explained through degeneracy, where structurally distinct configurations support the same function. However, real biological systems exhibit a more flexible form of degeneracy in which specialized circuits continually adapt towards new competencies through localized changes while preserving existing function. Deep learning studies degeneracy through mode connectivity, which connects same-task networks by low-loss curves, sheets, or volumes. However, the field lacks a counterpart to flexible degeneracy, which demands more than ordinary mode connectivity. Defining such an analogue requires asking whether many independently initialized models trained on distinct tasks can be connected by a high-dimensional region of multi-task solutions. translated_title: 《活点地图：贝塞尔流形揭示用于模型合并与集成的隐藏曲面》
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.33353v1 公告类型：新论文。摘要：神经回路以比深度网络更强的鲁棒性而著称，这通常通过“简并性”来解释，即结构上不同的配置可以支持相同的功能。然而，真实的生物系统表现出一种更灵活的简并形式：特化的回路通过局部化的改变不断适应新的能力，同时保留既有功能。深度学习领域通过“模式连通性”来研究简并性，即用低损失曲线、曲面或体积连接在同一任务上训练的网络。但该领域尚缺乏与“灵活简并”相对应的概念，而这需要超越普通的模式连通性。定义这样的类比需要回答的问题是：许多独立初始化、在不同任务上训练的模型，能否被一个高维的多任务解区域连接起来。我们提出了 Nimbus，它学习一个高维贝塞尔流形来连接 N 个专家模型，超越了单——（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出 Nimbus，通过学习连接 N 个不同任务专家模型的高维贝塞尔流形，将模式连通性扩展为“灵活简并”的类比，为模型合并与集成揭示隐藏的多任务解曲面。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces Nimbus, which learns a high-dimensional Bézier manifold connecting N task-specialist models, extending mode connectivity into an analogue of flexible degeneracy and revealing hidden multi-task solution surfaces for model merging and ensembling.
